citations.authors: Schneider KJ, Meeuwisse WH, Nettel-Aguirre A, et al.
citations.title: Cervicovestibular rehabilitation in sport-related concussion: a randomised controlled trial
citations.what_it_says: Landmark RCT: 73% of athletes with persistent symptoms receiving combined cervical + vestibular physiotherapy were medically cleared within 8 weeks versus 7% of controls.

citations.authors: Leddy JJ, Haider MN, Ellis MJ, et al.
citations.title: Early Subthreshold Aerobic Exercise for Sport-Related Concussion: A Randomized Clinical Trial
citations.what_it_says: First RCT of acute concussion treatment (Buffalo protocol): sub-symptom-threshold aerobic exercise sped recovery (13 vs 17 days) versus stretching.

citations.authors: Leddy JJ, Master CL, Mannix R, et al.
citations.title: Early targeted heart rate aerobic exercise versus placebo stretching for sport-related concussion in adolescents: a randomised controlled trial
citations.what_it_says: Multicentre replication: early targeted heart-rate aerobic exercise safely sped recovery and cut persistent post-concussive symptom risk by 48%.

citations.authors: Patricios JS, Schneider KJ, Dvorak J, et al.
citations.title: Consensus statement on concussion in sport: the 6th International Conference on Concussion in Sport — Amsterdam, October 2022
citations.what_it_says: Amsterdam CISG consensus recommends early active rehabilitation, cervicovestibular rehab, and sub-symptom aerobic exercise; directly endorsing the interventions in PT concussion training.

citations.authors: Schneider KJ, Leddy JJ, Guskiewicz KM, et al.
citations.title: Rest and treatment/rehabilitation following sport-related concussion: a systematic review
citations.what_it_says: Strict rest is not beneficial beyond 24-48 hours; active rehabilitation including cervicovestibular therapy improves recovery; the pivot from 'cocoon rest' to PT-led active management.

citations.authors: Galeno E, Pullano E, Mourad F, Galeoto G, Frontani F
citations.title: Effectiveness of Vestibular Rehabilitation after Concussion: A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trial
citations.what_it_says: Systematic review of 7 RCTs: vestibular rehabilitation effective for reducing dizziness and accelerating return to sport after concussion.

citations.authors: Mucha A, Collins MW, Elbin RJ, et al.
citations.title: A Brief Vestibular/Ocular Motor Screening (VOMS) assessment to evaluate concussions: preliminary findings
citations.what_it_says: Developed and validated the VOMS screening tool used by concussion-trained PTs to anchor vestibular/ocular triage.

citations.authors: Kontos AP, Sufrinko A, Sandel N, Emami K, Collins MW
citations.title: Sport-related Concussion Clinical Profiles: Clinical Characteristics, Targeted Treatments, and Preliminary Evidence
citations.what_it_says: Describes the six concussion clinical profiles and matched treatments; the 'clinical trajectories' framework forming ITPT's first curriculum module; evidence labeled preliminary by the authors.

citations.authors: Schatz P, Pardini JE, Lovell MR, Collins MW, Podell K
citations.title: Sensitivity and specificity of the ImPACT Test Battery for concussion in athletes
citations.what_it_says: Foundational (developer-affiliated) validation: 81.9% sensitivity and 89.4% specificity for ImPACT plus symptom scores; the most-cited supportive psychometric evidence.

citations.authors: Broglio SP, Ferrara MS, Macciocchi SN, Baumgartner TA, Elliott R
citations.title: Test-retest reliability of computerized concussion assessment programs
citations.what_it_says: CRITICAL: independent study found ImPACT had low-to-moderate test-retest reliability (ICCs 0.23-0.76), below accepted thresholds for clinical decision-making.

citations.authors: Resch J, Driscoll A, McCaffrey N, et al.
citations.title: ImPact test-retest reliability: reliably unreliable?
citations.what_it_says: CRITICAL: independent replication concluding clinicians should not rely on ImPACT scores in isolation; memory composites weakest.

citations.authors: Alsalaheen B, Stockdale K, Pechumer D, Broglio SP
citations.title: Validity of the Immediate Post Concussion Assessment and Cognitive Testing (ImPACT)
citations.what_it_says: CRITICAL: systematic review concluding ImPACT validity evidence is inconsistent and incomplete relative to the test's widespread clinical use.

citations.authors: Langevin P, Frémont P, Fait P, Dubé MO, Bertrand-Charette M, Roy JS
citations.title: Cervicovestibular Rehabilitation in Adults with Mild Traumatic Brain Injury: A Randomized Clinical Trial
citations.what_it_says: In 60 NON-athlete adults with persistent post-mTBI symptoms, cervicovestibular rehabilitation plus symptom-limited aerobic exercise improved post-concussion symptom severity; showing the rehab approach works beyond the athlete population.
